about_the_game:
BallStack is a vibrant match-3 game that challenges you to stack and match colorful balls—red, blue, purple, green, white and yellow—to clear levels and climb the leaderboard! With intuitive tap-to-match mechanics, you’ll strategize to create combos, earn power-ups, and tackle increasingly tricky puzzles. Perfect for casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike, BallStack offers:

  • Colorful Gameplay: Match red, blue, purple, green, white and yellow balls to clear the board.

  • Power-Ups & Boosters: Unlock special abilities to blast through tough spots.

  • Leaderboards: Compete with friends and players worldwide to become the ultimate BallStack champion.

  • Relaxing Fun: Enjoy a bright, cheerful art style and satisfying gameplay that’s easy to pick up, hard to master.

Dive into BallStack today and start stacking your way to victory!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 or AMD equivalent (dual-core, ~2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics or equivalent (integrated graphics capable of DirectX 9)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Quad Q8200 or AMD equivalent (quad-core, ~2.5 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 560 Ti or AMD Radeon HD 7850 (dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
